intro.label: The Academy
intro.title: A small academy, by design.
intro.p1: Élan Academy is one tutor and her students. There is no rotating staff and no crowded classroom: the person who meets you in the trial lesson is the person who teaches every lesson after it.
intro.p2: That scale is the point. It means a plan drawn for one student, progress that is noticed week by week, and a parent who always knows who to ask.

items.d: Every sound, letter and rule is placed correctly before anything is built on it.
Repetition with purpose turns careful work into ease.
A student who knows why they are right carries it into everything else.

foundation.name: Foundation
foundation.desc: Arabic letters, their sounds and first steps in reading the Quran, for students starting from the beginning.

tajweed.name: Quran Recitation and Tajweed
tajweed.desc: The rules of recitation: points of articulation, the qualities of each letter and how to apply them when reading.

hifz.name: Quran Memorisation
hifz.desc: A personal memorisation plan with regular revision, so what is learned stays learned.

arabic.name: Arabic Language
arabic.desc: Reading, writing, listening and speaking, covering both Quranic and everyday Arabic.

islamic-studies.name: Islamic Studies
islamic-studies.desc: Belief, worship, prophetic biography, hadith and manners, taught at the student's level.

why.label: Why Élan
why.title: What a single tutor makes possible.

items.d: The same tutor from the trial lesson onward. Nothing is lost between lessons.
Pace, material and revision are set for the student in front of her, not for a class.
The first lesson is free, so the decision is made on experience.
One to five lessons a week, in sessions of 30, 45 or 60 minutes.

Every lesson is taught by the academy's one tutor. You will not be passed between teachers.
Live, online and one-to-one. [The video platform will be confirmed here.]
